description: The 2018 National Population and Housing Census of Colombia (CNPV) is published by DANE in several open forms. The dwelling workbook gives, for every department and municipality and separately for municipal seats, populated centres and dispersed rural areas, the number of dwellings by occupancy and type, occupied dwellings by the predominant material of exterior walls and of floors, by the availability of public services (electricity, water supply, sewerage, piped gas, waste collection, internet), by type of toilet, and people by the electricity tariff stratum of their dwelling. A companion workbook covers households. The anonymised public-use microdata are downloadable by department from DANE's national data archive (ANDA), and the census can also be tabulated online in REDATAM or viewed on a geoviewer. DANE produced the census to count the population and describe housing conditions. Coverage: all of Colombia. Format and access: XLSX workbooks and zipped microdata files free without registration. Licence: use is free with the citation "Fuente: DANE"; the conditions forbid copying the data for sale, and licensed microdata with extra processing may carry a cost. Caveats: the workbook tables count only occupied dwellings with people present for most housing items, and block-level (manzana) results need the geoportal, whose download pages are rendered by JavaScript. Simulation uses: exposure models using wall and floor materials, service coverage gaps for water, sanitation and energy planning, and synthetic populations from the microdata. Related records: IPUMS International census microdata and the GHSL population grid.
